deals.travelWindow: Feb 13 – Apr 24, 2027 (new Allegiant route; intro one-way from $49)
deals.whyRanked: Still the cheapest fare on record (~$98 RT from Allegiant's Nov launch pricing, carried over; not re-confirmed today); Canaveral National Seashore ~50 min away.
deals.soloWhy: Cheap and easy with a rental car, but SFB is outside Orlando proper; best for beach and springs days rather than nightlife.

highlights: Canaveral National Seashore: Apollo Beach and Turtle Mound
Blue Spring State Park manatee season (Nov–Mar)
Lake Mary and Sanford Riverwalk for easy evenings
Kayaking the St. Johns River at Lake Monroe
itinerary: Day 1 — Land at SFB, Sanford Riverwalk and sunset on Lake Monroe
Day 2 — Blue Spring State Park for manatees, afternoon Winter Park boat tour
Day 3 — Apollo Beach sunrise at Canaveral, fly out
guide.gettingAround: Rental car is essential; SFB is small and the parks are not on transit.
guide.stayArea: Historic downtown Sanford for walkability and budget lodging.
food: Orlando area fish camps near Lake Monroe
